pj815gj2t0orv07b5ehijngghi.value: Credits: random numbers by the ZX81's generator (Sinclair Research, 1981; seed = 75 × (seed + 1) mod 65537 − 1); a fixed step after Glenn Fiedler's Fix Your Timestep (2004); the fireflies and the lamps' soft shadows spread by Martin Roberts's R2 sequence (2018); soft shadows by distributed ray tracing (Cook, Porter and Carpenter, 1984); ambient occlusion after Zhukov, Iones and Kronin (1998); the wall's light baked as Quake's lightmaps were (id Software, 1996); the drops lit by probes, an irradiance volume (Greger, Shirley, Hubbard and Greenberg, 1998) kept in circular harmonics as Sloan, Kautz and Snyder (2002) and Ramamoorthi and Hanrahan (2001) keep light in spherical ones; the fireflies' soft shadows by sphere tracing (Hart, 1996) the leaves' distance as Íñigo Quílez marches a soft shadow (2010), its distance kept as samples (Frisken, Perry, Rockwood and Jones, 2000); the hail by sequential impulses after Erin Catto's (2005, 2006) and Box2D Lite, the overlap pushed out as Baumgarte stabilised constraints (1972); the chips' touches by separating axes (Gottschalk, Lin and Manocha, 1996) and clipping (Gregorius, 2013; Box2D Lite); speculative contacts with the sill after Paul Firth (2011) and Erin Catto (GDC 2013).
